summary.selectionRule: Choose the prior with the largest positive discovery state-clustered Brier gain; ties go to the lower prior. If none is positive, select pass-only and do not test a mixture.

design: Out-of-family opponents: random-legal, tempo-open (max tiles then openings), anti-minus (public next-hand-size urgency, minimize next legal tile types, otherwise shed pips). Discovery grid of 10/20/50/80% closed-control prior weights; choose the largest positive state-clustered Brier gain (ties lower prior), then evaluate only that prior once on holdout; if none is positive, select pass-only. No oracle profile. Posterior marginalizes each synthetic family across last 3 observed tile-group choices. One public-pass-selected position/deal, same-tile different-end pair. Sample pass-compatible current hands deterministically; reconstruct earlier hands from public played tiles AFTER each observed choice, compute softmax likelihood of chosen tile GROUP (not branch label) under two assumed likelihood families (without knowing true opponent policy). Reweight identical worlds for both candidate next-pass labels. 10% uniform lapse, temperature=1, utility removedPips/3 + 6*mixedFinish - 4*openedDoubles for closed-branch-control. At most 3 most recent opponent play choices per opponent. Compare weighted MC against EXACT pass-only combinatorial posterior. Two disjoint seed halves. Hidden-world draws use replacement; unique complete hand/stock allocations are deduplicated and reported within each visible state.
limitations: Out-of-family deterministic bots are not humans. All prior-grid weights are hypothetical; choosing among four on discovery can overfit, so only one selected model is reported on the untouched holdout; importance sampling has finite-world variance and potentially low ESS; public selection enriched for informative passes; one publicly selected high-information position per deal; correlated two counterfactual actions; provisional branch number-lock and unresolved block winner/loneZero/bust/101. No human tactic inferred.
nextAction: Lock the discovery-selected prior and replicate once on a disjoint holdout; if its clustered interval again crosses zero, close the choice-likelihood line as unsupported and prioritize physical branch/block authentication.
